item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-R01-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-R01-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-R01-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-R01-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-R01-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Tribunal found 205 district tally records internally consistent and without evidenced error or inconsistency; it stated that inconsistencies in other records were to be analyzed and, where necessary, corrected, using the act data and, if needed, INE’s presidential-election results database.","notes":["The excerpt supports 205 consistent records and the stated review methodology, but does not establish that all remaining discrepancies were actually mathematically corrected."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0025-R01-E006","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt does not support the proposed summary about the election’s governing principles or its characterization as free, authentic, periodic, universal, secret, and direct; it instead concerns district-act omissions and corrections."]}]}
